nodes.name: timelineTicks.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit suite covering the timeline ruler tick-color mapping, including the engine's `changes_requested` aliasing and case-insensitive input handling.

nodes.name: timelineTicks.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helper that maps a timeline event type to the CSS custom-property color used by the replay ruler, honoring the v2 token palette for orchestration, worker, review, and ship events.

nodes.name: tickColorVar
nodes.summary: Lowercases the event type and switches over the known pact event names, returning the matching `var(--color-*)` string so the replay ruler tick paints the right semantic color.

nodes.name: setupTests.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest global setup that polyfills jsdom with the missing DOM/SVG APIs required by @xyflow/react and cmdk so the unit suite can mount nodes, edges, and the command palette.

nodes.name: tokens.css
nodes.summary: Dashboard v2 single-source-of-truth design token sheet: Tailwind v4 `@theme` block with the locked dark palette, role colors, semantic colors, radii, shadows, plus legacy role re-pointing for existing canvas components.

nodes.name: tokens.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression suite that reads `tokens.css` and `index.css` from disk and asserts the locked palette hexes are present, the legacy role vars are re-pointed, and the v1 light-theme hexes have been fully retired.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite + Vitest configuration wiring React, Tailwind v4, monorepo path aliases to the cloud packages, a manual chunk split that keeps the initial dashboard under Vercel's 500 kB budget, dev-server proxying of `/api`, and the jsdom unit-test scope.
